address.description: The name of the ip interface to listen to

dev.description: In this mode, Vault runs in-memory and starts unsealed. This option is not meant production but for development and testing i.e. for nixos tests.

devRootTokenID.description: Initial root token. This only applies when {option}`services.vault.dev` is true

listenerExtraConfig.description: Extra text appended to the listener section.

storageBackend.description: The name of the type of storage backend

storageConfig.description:
HCL configuration to insert in the storageBackend section.

Confidential values should not be specified here because this option's
value is written to the Nix store, which is publicly readable.
Provide credentials and such in a separate file using
[](#opt-services.vault.extraSettingsPaths).

tlsCertFile.description: TLS certificate file. TLS will be disabled unless this option is set

tlsKeyFile.description: TLS private key file. TLS will be disabled unless this option is set
